<observations>
Date: Apr 25, 2026
* 🔴 (07:12) User's overall renovation budget is $28,000 for a house in Asheville, North Carolina.
* 🔴 (07:45) User prefers quartz countertops over marble for durability.
* 🟡 (09:05) Agent identified QuickRaze as the lowest bid for demolition at $1,850.
* 🟡 (11:40) Agent found Cabinetry Creations offers a 10-year finish and 5-year hardware warranty for cabinets.
* 🔴 (12:15) User decided to order custom cabinets with a 2-door layout from Cabinetry Creations.
* ✅ (14:30) User approved the countertop sample and confirmed the order with StoneEdge (21-day lead time for 30 sq ft quartz slab).

Date: Apr 28, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User asked for an estimate on a farmhouse sink and faucet.
* 🟡 (08:25) Agent found RiverFlow Fixtures offers a 32-inch apron sink for $2,400 with a 14-day lead time.
* 🔴 (08:45) User decided to use Harbor Plumbing for installation and requested a timeline.
* 🟡 (09:10) Agent scheduled Harbor Plumbing for a 3-day installation window starting May 5.
* 🔴 (10:00) User asked about low-maintenance backsplash material options.
* 🟡 (10:45) Agent provided pricing for backsplash materials: SlateGray Porcelain ($8/sq ft), Sunburst Glass ($12/sq ft), EcoStone Composite ($9/sq ft).
* 🔴 (11:10) User selected EcoStone Composite for a 40-sq-ft backsplash, noting its limited stock and 2-week delivery.
* ✅ (12:15) User approved the backsplash material and added it to the project order.
* 🔴 (13:00) User inquired about permit requirements for new electrical outlets near the island.

Date: May 1, 2026
* 🔴 (13:45) User asked if a dedicated 20-amp circuit is required for new island countertop outlets.
* 🟡 (14:10) Agent confirmed a 20-amp dedicated circuit is recommended per National Electrical Code 2023.
* 🔴 (15:00) User decided to proceed with the electrical permit application for the project address.
* ✅ (15:50) Agent submitted the electrical permit request to the city Planning Office (3 business days processing).
* 🟡 (16:40) Agent received a quote from GranitePeak for a 30-sq-ft "Arctic White" quartz slab at $3,200 with a 10-day fabrication lead time.
* 🔴 (17:05) User selected "Arctic White" quartz and asked for delivery coordination.
* ✅ (18:00) Agent scheduled countertop delivery for May 7 and confirmed with GranitePeak.
* 🔴 (19:00) User confirmed a 36-inch built-in refrigerator model and requested a quote for a matching stainless-steel dishwasher.

Date: May 4, 2026
* 🔴 (08:10) User expressed interest in adding a pull-out pantry to lower cabinets and asked for cost estimates.
* 🟡 (09:00) Agent found a 24-inch pull-out pantry unit with soft-close hinges from CabinetCo for $1,150 (14-day lead time).
* ✅ (09:25) Agent added the pantry cost to the project budget.
* 🔴 (09:50) User approved the pantry addition and requested a matching backsplash design for the cooking zone.
* 🟡 (10:40) Agent found 12x12 inch light gray subway tiles from TileMosaic Co with an 8% bulk discount for orders over 150 tiles.
* ✅ (11:05) Agent ordered 200 tiles, securing the discount, for delivery on May 10.
* 🔴 (11:30) User asked about integrating under-cabinet LED strips with the new lighting plan.
* 🟡 (12:35) Agent generated a lighting layout including dimmable LED strips (5W/ft, compatible with existing circuit).
* ✅ (13:00) Agent sent LED strip specifications and installation guide to the user.
* 🔴 (13:30) User confirmed the LED strip model and instructed the assistant to arrange a site visit for final measurements on May 9.
* 🔴 (15:00) User prefers matte black cabinet hardware over brushed brass.

Date: May 8, 2026
* 🟡 (07:30) Agent confirmed the site-visit appointment for May 9 at 09:00 am.
* 🔴 (08:05) User asked if a "Storm Cloud" veining pattern quartz countertop would match the new backsplash.
* 🟡 (09:15) Agent found "Storm Cloud" quartz from StoneWorks at $78/sq ft (10-day lead time).
* ✅ (09:50) Agent added the countertop estimate to the budget, noting an increased total.
* 🔴 (10:20) User approved the "Storm Cloud" quartz option and requested a matching undermount faucet model.
* 🟡 (11:40) Agent found "AquaFlow-2000" undermount faucet with pull-down sprayer in brushed nickel for $210 (2-year warranty, 3-day delivery).
* ✅ (12:10) Agent sent faucet specifications and delivery estimate to the user.
* 🔴 (13:00) User confirmed the faucet selection and asked to schedule the plumber for installation on May 15.
* 🟡 (14:30) Agent found PlumbRight senior tech Carlos Ramos is available for faucet installation on May 15.
* ✅ (15:15) Agent booked Carlos Ramos for the faucet install and added it to the project timeline.
* 🔴 (16:00) User inquired whether the countertop sample could be delivered to the job site before the site-visit for on-site color verification.

Date: May 12, 2026
* 🟡 (07:15) Drywall demolition deadline is May 18.
* 🔴 (07:50) User asked if new backsplash tiles could be ordered in a matte ivory finish to match the upcoming paint scheme.
* 🟡 (09:10) Agent found matte ivory 12x12 porcelain tiles from TileMasters (500 sq ft available, 5% discount for orders over 300 sq ft).
* ✅ (09:45) Agent added the tile order to the procurement list with a provisional delivery date of May 20.
* 🔴 (10:20) User confirmed the tile choice and instructed the assistant to place the order immediately.
* ✅ (12:30) Agent ordered 450 sq ft of matte ivory tiles from TileMasters, including freight insurance, and sent confirmation/tracking to the user (estimated shipping May 20-22).
* 🔴 (13:15) User inquired about warranty coverage for new cabinets from CabinetCraft.
* 🟡 (15:10) Agent found CabinetCraft offers a 10-year structural warranty and a 2-year finish warranty, with a walnut cabinet set with brushed bronze hardware for the kitchen island priced at $4,200.
* ✅ (16:40) Agent added the CabinetCraft quote to the budget, noting a 12% increase.
* 🟢 (17:20) User mentioned the electrician's name is Dale Okonkwo.
* 🔴 (18:05) User approved the cabinet selection and asked the assistant to schedule installation for the week of May 25.
</observations>
<current-task>
Primary: Schedule CabinetCraft cabinet installation for the week of May 25.
Secondary:
- Obtain a quote for a matching stainless-steel dishwasher.
- Arrange for the "Storm Cloud" quartz countertop sample to be delivered to the job site before the May 9 site visit for on-site color verification.
</current-task>
<suggested-response>
The assistant should confirm the site visit for May 9 and address the user's request regarding the countertop sample delivery.
</suggested-response>
